summary: Phase 5 MEMBER portal E2E tested on https://pmt-repo-restore.preview.emergentagent.com with real Supabase data. Created PMT-TEST fixtures (client 49 / project 59 / deliverable 55 / stages 101 Content=complete + 102 Design=pending, department Design) via Supabase REST, then ran the full lifecycle through the UI: Manager assign -> Member Submit -> Manager approve -> Simulate Client Request Changes -> Member View Feedback + Resume Work -> Submit again -> Manager approve -> Simulate Client Approval -> Completed. All 10 requested scenarios PASSED, including DB verification that assignToStageAction writes BOTH assignee='harsh belsare' and assignee_user_id='3cc5f0d5-db34-4835-a722-94942a1dbc12' in the same update while status moved pending->in_progress. Security: unauth /member -> /login, Admin -> /admin, Manager -> /manager. Ownership isolation confirmed: prod stage 92 (assignee text = 'harsh belsare', assignee_user_id NULL) never appeared on the Member dashboard, proving there is no name-based fallback. KPIs tracked real data at every step (pending 0->1->0, tasks 1 active -> 1 completed, campaigns 1 active -> 1 completed) and dropped to all-zero + the 3 empty-state strings after fixture cleanup. All PMT-TEST fixtures deleted; a post-cleanup query confirms 0 deliverable_stages rows have a non-null assignee_user_id, i.e. the 27/35 production stages remain unassigned and untouched. No server errors in /var/log/supervisor/nextjs.err.log (only non-blocking Node 20 EBADENGINE warnings).
